mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% indicates labor market weakness that signals economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days when both series fall by more than 0.5% month-over-month.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decline > 0.5% MoM and RSAFS decline > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: The joint decline condition fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases (i.e., SPX returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances).

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing production index below 100 during late-cycle expansion signals supply chain stress and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO < 100 during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates robust economic activity, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods of positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation exceeding 3.5% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent price pressures that may prompt aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days in high inflation environments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Weak employment growth (PAYEMS) combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days when both conditions occur simultaneously.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth < 0.1% MoM and UNRATE rise > 0.1pp MoM
failure_condition: The joint condition fails to predict negative returns in more than 35% of cases (i.e., SPX returns are positive in >35% of triggered instances).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.0% during early-cycle expansion signals economic fragility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% during early-cycle expansion.
